scenes.name: Salto Ángel
scenes.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished background bitmap for a 2D Venezuelan arcade fighting game, landscape aspect ratio 27:16.
Style: beautiful, authentic hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art, crisp visible square pixels, clustered highlights and dithering, rich but controlled palette, cinematic layered environment like premium SNES/Neo Geo backgrounds. No smooth vector shapes, no photographic textures, no blurry gradients. Raster pixel illustration.
Composition: side-on fixed camera; distant landmark across the top 70% of the canvas, middle distance details below. The bottom 20% is a quiet open foreground reserved for a coded fighting floor and characters. Keep the middle of the image readable and luminous, with a clear silhouette. No fighters, no human figures, no UI, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not draw floating game platforms: those are drawn and animated separately in code. One single continuous backdrop, no panels, no sprite sheet.
Scene: Kerepakupai Merú / Salto Ángel in Canaima, Venezuela. A majestic flat-topped ochre sandstone Auyán-tepui rising above dense emerald rainforest, the slender white waterfall descending down its sheer cliff, delicate mist pooling over the canopy, a luminous blue morning sky with pale pixel clouds. Compose the main waterfall slightly right of center. Lower foreground is a dark quiet mossy rock ledge at the jungle edge. Palette: turquoise, deep jade, sandstone copper, pale cream, warm morning light. Make the distinct tepuy and waterfall unmistakable, magical but geographically recognizable.
